narrative: Material PL1__M0419476 exhibits volatile continuous demand with a daily mean of 551 units (CV=0.38) over 172 working days. Lead times average 0.73 days with unstable variability (CV=1.25), yielding a combined lead-time demand sigma of 499 units. An (r,Q) policy with safety stock 700, reorder point 702, and order quantity 2337 (capped from EOQ 2337 by storage limit) achieves the 95% service level while keeping total annual inventory costs at $3,938, a $158 saving vs the current SAP policy.
warnings: Order quantity capped from 2337 to 2337 due to storage limit of 5240 units. This may increase ordering frequency and annual ordering costs.
High demand variability (CV=0.38). Safety stock may underestimate true buffer need under extreme demand scenarios.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is continuous with high frequency (non-zero=100%) and moderate-to-high volume (mean=551 units/day). Lead times are short (mean=0.73 days) and unstable. An (r,Q) policy with fixed EOQ-based order quantity and a reorder point calculated from lead-time demand distribution provides the best cost-service balance.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap of 5240 units constrains the order quantity to 2337 (unconstrained EOQ = 2337). This does not affect annual ordering frequency to 59.2 orders/year, adding ordering cost pressure. Service level target (95%) remains achievable with safety stock of 700 units.
